payload.title: M2: Sandbox — block network and credentials for student code
payload.description: Intent: As the maintainer, I want student programs to run without network access or cloud credentials, so that untrusted code cannot reach the internet or the AWS account. Includes: small C launcher using libseccomp (denies socket for AF_INET/AF_INET6, no_new_privs), scrubbed environment, no task-role permissions, ulimits/process caps against fork bombs, proof on real Fargate. Excludes: private-subnet/VPC-endpoint egress blocking (revisit if more students join). DoD: Python socket.connect and C connect() fail with EPERM; credential/metadata reads fail; specs pass locally and on Fargate.
